A precise, photoreal studio product render of a premium device by a top industrial design studio: A long horizontal control unit in brushed aluminium floats in the black void: a central landscape screen set in a black glass panel, a large round machined dial at each end.

The output is one single photograph, landscape 16:9.

Composition A, centred and symmetric: the design surface sits on the centre line, square to the camera, with even space on both sides; strong verticals and horizontals run parallel to the frame. Shot: Camera straight on, 100mm lens. The unit spans about 80 percent of the frame width on the centre line; the screen fills about 40 percent of the frame width, sharp, perfectly square-on; the dials have fine knurled edges catching the light; a thin highlight runs along the top chamfer. Nobody is in frame.

Place: A pure black seamless void; nothing else in the frame but the device.

Light: One large soft key light from above and one side, with a thin rim light: crisp highlights running along machined edges and chamfers, soft gradients on brushed metal, the rest falling to pure black.

Palette and grade: Neutral and cool: brushed aluminium, satin steel, matte black and graphite on pure black; the screen a clean neutral white. The same grade on every image of the collection.

Real: this is a product mockup render, so the screen is the hero: large, sharp and fully readable, glowing evenly. It is a flawless photoreal render with real material physics: fine brushed-metal grain, precise machined chamfers, tight tolerances, tiny screws and seams. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the device named is in frame.

Design surface: THE SCREEN SHOWS A PLAIN WHITE FULL-SCREEN IMAGE, evenly lit edge to edge, crisp corners inside its black border, nothing on it.

Finish: Ultra-precise, high-end industrial-design render: perfectly clean, sharp detail, accurate reflections, subtle depth; no noise, no clutter, no text.

Avoid: logos, letters, numbers or brand names anywhere, any image, icon or text on the screen, any object other than the device, a cheap plastic look, a cartoon or toy look.
